bio: Goce Delčev, born in Kukuš in 1872, was the leading figure of the Macedonian Revolutionary Organisation and its best-known ideologue. He travelled across Macedonia as a teacher and organiser, building the movement for an autonomous Macedonia. He was killed by Ottoman troops at Banica in May 1903, weeks before the Ilinden Uprising. In 1946 his remains were brought to Skopje and laid in the courtyard of the Church of the Holy Saviour.
